mapper.select: SELECT M.sectionId, M.id, M.parentId, CASE WHEN M.elmtCclsCd = '7' THEN ISNULL(REGEXP_REPLACE(D.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/'), M.content) ELSE M.content END AS content, M."desc" FROM ( SELECT A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS sectionId, A.MDFM_CPEM_ID AS id, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID AS parentId, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN A.ELMT_BSC_CNTE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(C.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') ELSE COALESCE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, C.DCST_LDAT) END AS content, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE END AS "desc", A.ELMT_CCLS_CD AS elmtCclsCd, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN ( ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ELMT_CCLS_CD ORDER BY A.MDFM_CPEM_ID) - 1) ELSE -1 END AS imageSeq FROM ODS.S_MRFMFCID A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRECE B ON B.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND B.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = B.MDFM_CPEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRLFE C ON C.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND C.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = C.MDFM_CPEM_ID WHERE A.MDFM_ID = #{mdfmId} AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = #{mdfmFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' ORDER BY A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ, A.MDFM_CPEM_ID, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID ) M LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRIMD D ON D.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND D.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND M.imageSeq = D.IMG_SEQ
